services.name: Great White Shark & Marine Life Tour (5 Hours)
services.desc: Welcome aboard the Sanctuary for a tour of Monterey Bay in search of the great white shark! Limited to 15 passengers 5 hours 30 minutes What to expect June and July is great white shark season! Temperatures at the shark zone are usually in the 70 to 80 Fahrenheit range. It will still be chilly to and from so layer your clothes. All departures at 11:00 am. We travel North to a protected cove, where we will see sharks basking on the surface in these shallow waters. We could see other wildlife such as whales, sea otters, sea lions and dolphins but the main goal is the great white. On Limited to 15 passengers

quotes.author: Melissa G
quotes.text: AMAZING!!!! We found an orca pod hunting a sea lion who was using our boat for refuge! Chase was very knowledgeable, very friendly staff with everything you need right on the boat!!

quotes.author: Kary M
quotes.text: Found this cruise last minute. We saw humpback whales and orcas! We found them both real fast. Amazing trip and I'll definitely take any of my friends that come to visit.

Joey and Luke were incredibly welcoming and fun!! I'm glad our group chose this smaller boat rather than a larger option. We were able to see almost 30 sea lions and 8 humpback whales teaming up to catch anchovies and it was incredible!! Super unique to get to see this before our eyes! The sporty conditions made this experience even more exciting, we felt like we were on a rollercoaster! Thank you Joey for being an excellent captain, and Luke for your warmth and knowledge - plus he's an author! Crazy!

We opted for the 6 seat boat which offered fantastic flexibility and maneuverability (note: no potty on board this new vessel of their fleet, so plan ahead). Captain Mike is phenomenal and we caught plenty of whale, dolphin, sea otter and sea lion sightings. Fantastic experience!
